description: Impulse generator: a burst of coloured noise shaped by a window function, started by a gate and repeated for as long as that gate is high

params.text: Picks the colour of the noise in the burst: white, pink, red, violet, grey, blue or black
Picks the window function that shapes the burst: none, triangle, Welch, sine, Hanning, Blackman, Nutall or Kaiser, with its name printed under the display
Sets how long one burst lasts, 0.1ms to 100ms
Sets how many peaks the window is folded into within one burst, 1 to 4
Sets how long after one burst begins the next one begins while the gate is high, 1ms to 1000ms

inputs.text: Adds to the noise colour, 10V stepping from white through to black
Adds to the window function, 10V stepping across all eight
Adds to the burst length, 10V covering the whole 0.1ms to 100ms range
Adds to the peak count, 10V covering 1 to 4 peaks
Adds to the repeat time, 10V covering the whole 1ms to 1000ms range
A rising edge here starts a burst, and while this is above 0V the burst starts again at the repeat time

notes: nothing comes out until a gate or a trigger is patched into the gate input; there is no free-running mode, and the output rests at 0V between bursts
